messages:
sam: Opening idea — can we standardize an 'exit gate' for v1 retirements so they're predictable?
maya: Yes. What would it include?
sam: Telemetry thresholds, quota/billing guardrails, routing fallback, console gating/UX, runbook + rollbacks.
andre: Telemetry: what exact signals? :thinking_face:
sam: Propose: success_rate >= 99.5% (v2 vs v1), latency P95 <= 1.2x of v1, semantic regression pass >= 98% over 24h.
sam: Example probe query:
```
SELECT sample_id, prompt_hash, model_variant, success, latency_ms
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE time > now() - interval '24 hours'
AND tag = 'v1_migration_probe'
LIMIT 10000;
```
jules: Probe cohort size? 0.1% seems small.
li: 0.5-1% depending on tenant. Aim for ~10k samples/day per major tenant.
maya: Quotas — avoid billing surprises. Mapping rules?
sam: Map v1 tokens -> v2 estimated tokens using per-model compression ratio; cap temporary multiplier at 2x; console shows "estimated v2 token impact" before flip.
andre: Do we already surface compression ratios?
li: Yes, metrics.model_token_ratio has median ratios; can precompute tenant impact.
carla: Console UX: per-tenant deprecation banner + "Force v2" opt-in with cost/diff preview. Add health color (red/amber/green) from telemetry.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary cohort created: v1_migration_probe size=0.75% started at 1755601400
maya: Routing: sticky token affinity for 7d after flip to help session continuity.
andre: Fallback: if error spike > 0.7% over 15m, route token back to v1; auto-rollback window 30m and alert tenant owner.
sam: Quota backstop: if mapped-cost > 1.5x baseline in 1h, throttle to baseline +10% and notify billing.
jules: Dashboards: per-tenant "migration health" with P95, success_rate, semantic_regressions, token_ratio, cost_estimate.
li: I'll add backend signals and a summary widget. Need event schema for cohort marking: `migration_cohort:true` on requests.
carla: Add console action "Run migration dry-run" to simulate routing and expected split.
maya: Runbook: steps for on-call: revert routing, revoke cohort flag, escalate to infra, attach trace IDs.
sam: So thresholds: success 99.5%, latency P95 <=1.2x, semantic eval >=98%, probe cohort 0.5-1%, rollback triggers as discussed. Thumbs?
andre: +1
jules: +1
li: +1
maya: +1
carla: I'll draft runbook + console mocks today.
sam: I'll open RFC PR and include dashboard reqs. Thanks everyone :+1:
